# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 17 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 14 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 4 tokens; Border width — 3 tokens; Container — 5 tokens; Breakpoint — 5 tokens; Z index — 7 tokens; Icon size — 6 tokens; Fluid — 7 tokens; Transition — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #313131);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #313131;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #313131 | Observé (Figma). Fond de page unique du site (toutes les sections, header, footer). Sol de tout le texte `text-*`. |
| `--surface-raised` | #3d3d3d | Proposé. Champs de formulaire, menus déroulants, cartes, modale. Un cran au-dessus de `surface` pour séparer sans ombre. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #262626 | Proposé. Panneau du menu mobile et pied de modale ; zones en retrait. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one. Crossroads (pochoir) en MAJUSCULES, approche 0,08em. Mots en `text-primary` (blanc) ; chiffres et ponctuation en `primary` (orange) et en Montserrat 800, car la police n'a pas ces glyphes (chiffres en filigrane). `accentTitle()` les isole automatiquement. Montserrat, texte et liens à 16 px (demande client ; 18–20 px dans la maquette). Approche 0,08em en desktop. Nunito n'apparaît que sur ces trois usages dans la maquette ; ne pas l'étendre ailleurs.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 44px/48px Crossroads, Montserrat, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: 0.08em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/Crossroads-Regular.ttf`, `fonts/Montserrat-300.woff2`, `fonts/Montserrat-400.woff2`, `fonts/Montserrat-700.woff2` and `fonts/Montserrat-800.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Crossroads-Regular.ttf` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Crossroads-Regular.ttf`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Crossroads | `fonts/Crossroads-Regular.ttf` (weight 400) | `read fonts/Crossroads-Regular.ttf` | `var(--font-display)` | `crossroads` |
| Montserrat | `fonts/Montserrat-400.woff2` (weight 400) | `read fonts/Montserrat-400.woff2` | `var(--font-display)` | `montserrat` |

Every face: `fonts/Crossroads-Regular.ttf` (Crossroads, 400), `fonts/Montserrat-300.woff2` (Montserrat, 300), `fonts/Montserrat-400.woff2` (Montserrat, 400), `fonts/Montserrat-700.woff2` (Montserrat, 700), `fonts/Montserrat-800.woff2` (Montserrat, 800).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */

```

### Tokens (14)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Proposé. Écart icône/texte minimal, étoiles (observé 3–5 px). |

| `--space-4` | 16px | Proposé. Gouttière mobile, padding des champs. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Proposé. Écart entre éléments d'une carte ; padding des alertes. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Observé (Figma). Titre → paragraphe (observé 29 px, arrondi). |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Observé (Figma). Padding horizontal des boutons (observé 40–46 px, unifié). |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Proposé. Écart entre colonnes ; titre de section → contenu en mobile. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Observé (Figma). Paragraphe → bouton (observé 59 px). |
| `--space-20` | 80px | Proposé. Écart vertical entre sections en tablette. |
| `--space-24` | 96px | Proposé. Écart vertical entre sections en laptop. |
| `--space-30` | 120px | Observé (Figma). Écart entre sections desktop (observé 120 à 180 px, unifié à 120 ; 160 pour le hero). |
| `--space-40` | 160px | Observé (Figma). Hero → première section en desktop. |
| `--gutter-page` | 127px | Observé (Figma). Marge latérale du contenu sur la maquette 1920 px (contenu 1666 px). En dessous de 1920 px, la largeur est plafonnée par `container-max`. |

## Fluid

Tailles fluides proposées pour le responsive : de 375 px à 1920 px.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--fs-display: clamp(26px, 1.3rem + 1.4vw, 44px)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--fs-display), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--fs-display` | clamp(26px, 1.3rem + 1.4vw, 44px) | Demandé par le client : titres réduits. Taille du H1 : 26 px en mobile → 44 px. |
| `--fs-h2` | clamp(22px, 1.15rem + 1vw, 36px) | Demandé par le client : titres réduits. Titres de section : 22 px en mobile → 36 px. |
| `--fs-h4` | clamp(20px, 1.1rem + 0.3vw, 24px) | Titres d'étape de fidélité : 20 → 24 px. |
| `--fs-numeral` | clamp(72px, 3.8rem + 2.6vw, 110px) | Chiffres fantômes des étapes : 72 → 110 px. |

| `--fs-body` | 16px | Demandé par le client. Texte courant à 16 px sur toutes les largeurs. |
| `--ls-body` | clamp(0.5px, 0.2px + 0.08vw, 1.28px) | Approche du texte courant : 0,08em (1,28 px) en desktop, 0,5 px en mobile. |

| `--ease-standard` | cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) | Proposé. Courbe de toutes les transitions. |
